units.source_text: 大约又过了两三天，夫人和小姐一早就出门了，说是去住在市谷的亲戚家。

en.t: About two or three more days passed, and early one morning the mistress and the young lady went out, saying they were going to stay with relatives in Ichigaya.

units.source_text: 那时K和我还没有开学，便留在了家里。

en.t: At that time K and I had not yet gone back to school, so we stayed at home.

units.source_text: 我既不愿意看书，也不想出去散步，只是将两个胳膊肘支在火盆边上，托着腮帮子想心事。

en.t: I did not feel like reading, nor did I want to go out for a walk; I merely propped both elbows on the edge of the brazier, rested my chin in my hands, and brooded.

units.source_text: 隔壁的K也悄无声息，屋子里静得互相不知对方是不是在房间里。

en.t: K in the next room was silent too, and the house was so quiet that neither of us could tell whether the other was in his room.

units.source_text: 这种情况在我们之间已不是什么稀罕事了，因此我也没有特别在意。

en.t: This sort of thing was no longer unusual between us, so I did not pay it any special attention.

units.source_text: 到了十点左右，K突然拉开隔扇，盯着我看。

en.t: Around ten o'clock, K suddenly slid open the partition screen and stared at me.

units.source_text: 他站在门槛上，问我在想什么。

en.t: Standing on the threshold, he asked me what I was thinking about.

units.source_text: 我本来也没想什么，如果说想了，那么多半也是像往常一样，在想小姐吧。

en.t: I had not really been thinking about anything, but if I had been thinking, it was probably about the young lady, as usual.

units.source_text: 想小姐自然会连带着想到夫人，而且近来K也像个无法分离的人一样，总是在我的脑子里转悠，使这个问题复杂化了。

en.t: Thinking of the young lady naturally brought the mistress to mind as well, and lately K too had been circling constantly in my thoughts, as if he could not be separated from them, making the whole matter more complicated.

units.source_text: 虽然以前一直朦胧地觉得他是个障碍，可当我这样同他四目相对时，却不能直言不讳地说出来。

en.t: Although I had long vaguely felt that he was an obstacle, when I met his eyes like this I could not say so frankly.

units.source_text: 此时我依然望着他的脸，沉默不语。

en.t: At that moment I still looked at his face and remained silent.

units.source_text: 他索性走进屋来，在我正烤着的火盆跟前坐了下来。

en.t: He then simply came into the room and sat down in front of the brazier where I had been warming myself.

units.source_text: 我赶忙从火盆上收回胳膊，将火盆往K那边稍微推了推。

en.t: I quickly drew my arms back from the brazier and pushed it a little toward K.
